therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: antibody-drug conjugate targeting tissue factor with MMAE payload
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: tumor cell killing via microtubule disruption after tissue factor-mediated internalization
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: patients with platinum-resistant ovarian, fallopian tube, or peritoneal cancer
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: confirmed objective response rate (ORR) according to RECIST v1.1

results.target_engagement_evidence: PK data showed ADC Cmax 20.6-21.8 µg/mL and free MMAE Cmax 1.8-2.6 ng/mL
safety_signals: Small intestinal obstruction SAEs in 3/79 patients
